احرنجمن (form IIIq)
# اِحْرَنْجَمْنَ (iḥranjamna) /iħ.ran.d͡ʒam.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِحْرَنْجَمَ (iḥranjama)
# اِحْرَنْجِمْنَ (iḥranjimna) /iħ.ran.d͡ʒim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِحْرَنْجَمَ (iḥranjama)
